name: C3DR
description: Humans exhibit an innate capacity to rapidly perceive and segment objects from video observations, and even mentally assemble them into structured 3D scenes. Replicating such capability, termed compositional 3D reconstruction, is pivotal for the advancement of Spatial Intelligence and Embodied AI. However, existing methods struggle to achieve practical deployment due to the insufficient integration of cross-modal information, leaving them dependent on manual object prompting, reliant on auxiliary visual inputs, and restricted to overly simplistic scenes by training biases.
